canEditAccess.description: Allow editing this state field's access mode when its collection allows editing existing fields.

persistent.description: Save this state's configured value in the local project. False means runtime only. When omitted, writable fields are persistent and read-only fields are not.

publishable.description: Allow the saved value in reusable components and shared graphs. False excludes the value, not the field definition. Runtime state broadcasting is unaffected. When omitted, persistent fields are publishable unless redactOnPublish is true.

redactOnPublish.description: If true, clear this state's saved value when exporting a publish-safe session JSON.
